what: Live check of the boot route POST /_sb_boot/<name>/<version> of lab/functions/main/index.ts (F2.1), run by run.sh in this folder against the pinned edge-runtime image in one throwaway container with the production launch flags (384m with swap equal, 0.5 CPU, 256 pids, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, read only root, 32m noexec tmpfs for /tmp and the Deno cache, the current unprivileged user). Removed afterwards. Run twice: the second run, recorded here, is on the main service with the boot route limited to two at a time and a worker lifetime of 15 seconds.

reading: A syntax error, a missing import and a folder without an entry point are refused with 422 and the runtime's message; the message carries container paths that functions-write.ts bootMessage removes.
A top level throw is NOT caught by worker creation (200): the page and the docs say so.
Only a service_role token of the environment opens the route; no token, an anon token, a wrong method and malformed names are refused (401, 401, 405, 400).
A live function and an unknown function answer as before (200, 404).
The route answers 429 with retry-after when two boots are already running (unit logic in main/index.ts; not provoked live because a boot takes about 20 ms).
not_established: an https or npm import the first time (network and cache): the control plane waits 20 seconds and treats a timeout as unreachable
memory held by a worker created with forceCreate until its workerTimeoutMs of 5 seconds
the route through the public gateway: it is not reachable there (a name starting with an underscore), checked by tests/functions.test.ts for the gateway side
